title: Transparency log anchor
description: A canonical record binding one verdict journal head to one transparency-log entry. Rekor or SCITT provides external ordering and public availability; this record is not evidence that the journal's claims are true, and it does not by itself stop an attacker who controls both the repository and the anchoring pipeline.

kind.description: The transparency-log family. Provider-specific bytes are stored under inclusion_proof or signed_entry.

journal_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact journal bytes named by the entry.

journal_head.description: Hash of the journal's last entry.

provider.description: Instance or adapter identity, for example public-rekor or scitt-sandbox.

entry_id.description: Rekor UUID or SCITT entry ID.

log_index.description: Provider's append-only log index, when available.

log_id.description: Transparency log key or instance identifier.

log_root.description: Signed tree head or log root observed by the provider command.

inclusion_proof.description: Provider-specific inclusion proof. Its semantics belong to the provider adapter.

signed_entry.description: Provider-specific signed entry or receipt bytes, preserved as an object.

provider_output_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the provider's raw JSON output when the record was created.

anchored_at.description: ISO 8601 publication or observation time with an offset.
